invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.18.0 preserves Parts 1–17, Kenya eTIMS and international e-invoicing while keeping the standalone responsive module shell readable: long labels, customer names and fiscal records wrap instead of being clipped. Tutorial launchers are not duplicated in Invoicing page headers/topbars; tutorial activation is centralized in Settings -> Workspace and defaults off until explicitly enabled. Migrations remain additive.
